title: Household Waste Survey and Characterisation in Gulu City, Uganda
text: figure generation--area shows per capita waste generation rate 94 households included study’s averages, one point per household, grouped study area ordered median area. Generation differs areas two divisions, every area households generate far rest.
code: library(guluswm) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  set.seed(2026) analysed <- guluswm_waste |>   filter(included_in_averages == "Yes") |>   mutate(area = reorder(area, generation_kg_cap_day, FUN = median))  medians <- analysed |>   group_by(area, division) |>   summarise(median = median(generation_kg_cap_day), n = n(), .groups = "drop")  ggplot(analysed, aes(x = generation_kg_cap_day, y = area)) +   geom_jitter(aes(colour = division), height = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +   geom_point(data = medians, aes(x = median), shape = 124, size = 8) +   geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = 1.45, label = paste0("n = ", n)),             hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +   scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.6), breaks = seq(0, 1.5, 0.25)) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Bardege-Layibi` = "#B5473B",                                  `Laroo-Pece` = "#5B8E7D")) +   labs(x = "Waste generation (kg per person and day)", y = NULL,        colour = "Division",        title = "Household waste generation by study area, Gulu City, 2026",        subtitle = "One point per household; the bar marks the median of the area") +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Seven day household waste characterisation in Gulu City, Uganda, 2026 — guluswm_waste
text: tibble 95 rows 55 variables record_id Identifier characterisation record: CH, batch number running number, example CH-1001-001. enumerator Code enumerator recorded measurement, one codes E1 E5 shared guluswm_survey. measurement_date Date household's waste weighed sorted, 1 3 October 2026, end storage period. area Study area household correction study team: Limo, Vanguard, Highland, Kanyagoga, Pabbo Quarters Goans Quarters. area_recorded Study area recorded field form. field kept previous entry two enumerators switched areas; study team corrected 14 records enumerators' daily area logs field supervision records (see area). division Administrative division Gulu City household lives: Bardege-Layibi Laroo-Pece. household_form_id Household number written field form bags, example HH-01, used field supervision; restarts per enumerator area unique, record_id identifies household. occupants Number people living household. people_home_daytime Number household members home day. days_stored Number days household stored waste bags provided: 7 every household one test run, stored 14 days. person_days Occupants multiplied days_stored, denominator per capita generation rate. weight_recorded_kg Total weight household's waste recorded field, kilograms, correction keying errors. weight_fractions_sum_kg Sum weights 16 sorted fractions container deduction, kilograms. weight_used_kg Total weight household's waste used generation rate, kilograms: recorded total, except one keying error (CH-1001-012, grams entered kilograms), sum sorted fractions used. mass_balance_diff_pct Difference recorded total weight sum sorted fractions, percentage recorded total weight. title: guluswm 1.0.0
text: Initial release. Two data objects Gulu City household solid waste study: guluswm_survey, household survey 424 households (23 26 September 2026, 46 variables, survey weight division wealth index score class), guluswm_waste, seven day waste characterisation 95 households (1 3 October 2026, 55 variables, weights 16 fractions container deduction). raw data authors’ corrected final copy 3 November 2026, archived data-raw/. authors’ decision, household coordinates, enumerator user names free text answers published; enumerators appear codes E1 E5, also household_id. data dictionary carries variable descriptions confirmed authors. analysis/validate_data.R recomputes summary figures study, analysis/data_quality.R reports missing values, duplicates, range cross-field checks outliers. Everyone contributed data listed author: study team, four enumerators Charles Wakhata (logistics field support). Reviewed pkgreview standard 1.7.0 (#9, #11, #13, #15).
